title: Step 5b in-session validation report
description: Structured report Claude writes after applying the Step 5b subset of structural lints against the Step 5 emissions. Persisted at intermediate/step_5b_report.json.

format_version.description: Frozen at 1.0 for the initial Step 5b gate.

verdict.description: pass = zero mismatches found; fixed = mismatches found and edited in place; fail = at least one mismatch could not be repaired in-session.

files_checked.description: Relative paths (from the package root) of the Step 5 emissions Claude enumerated. Typically a subset of pipeline.py, requirements.py, slots.py, tools.py, constrained_slots.py, mobjects.py, loader.py.

call_sites_enumerated.description: Total count of Mellea-stdlib call sites visited across files_checked. Optional; used for telemetry.

line.description: 1-indexed line number of the offending call site. May be null if the issue is structural (e.g. import path).

issue.description: Short lint-id-style description of the defect (e.g. 'stdlib-arity', 'import-soundness', 'instruct-has-description').

fix_summary.description: One-line explanation of the edit Claude applied (e.g. 'rewrote check(req) to check(req, ctx)', 'changed mellea.backends.tools to mellea.stdlib.tools').

reason_unfixable.description: Optional. Why Claude could not repair in-session (e.g. 'canonical signature not in mellea_api_ref.json', 'symbol not present in surface — upstream rework needed').

remaining_issues.description: Issues Claude detected but could NOT repair in-session. Verdict MUST be 'fail' when this list is non-empty.
